name: myth-buster-stitch
label: Myth-buster: claim -> look closely -> evidence with PiP -> face -> origin receipt
description: From E1 Dr Karan Rajan toilet-roll myth (75k likes): voice from 0.0 s at 230-240 wpm, the myth shown as its artefact, labelled evidence images with the expert as a PiP (or the editor's split layout), a layout change every 4-6 s, the origin post as the receipt, a one-line verdict.

_needs_feature.broll.mode pip_corner: expert PiP bottom-right at ~35% width over full-frame evidence (today: split top/bottom or pip default position)
_needs_feature.annotate: red circle / arrow on an evidence still at a given xy and time; sfx 'pop'
_needs_feature.evidence_labels: small label text placed on the evidence image (from beat.label)
_needs_feature.myth_card: the claim recreated as a social-post card (name masked) when the original can't be shown
